zh.text: 这一轮只做一件事：写好开头段。产物先过确定性闸门，闸门不绿不许宣布完成。

en.text: One job this round: write the opening. The artifact must pass the deterministic gate first — no completion claim before it is green.

zh.text: 请求写入初稿（预设示意，不会真实执行）。

zh.text: check failed: 开头两句不符合句式规则，退出码 1。

en.text: check failed: the first two sentences break the style rule. Exit code 1.

zh.text: 闸门挡住了完成声明——这正是它的工作。诊断：开头太绕。修掉后重跑同一个闸门，不许绕过。

en.text: The gate blocked the completion claim — that is its job. Diagnosis: the opening buries the point. Fix it and rerun the SAME gate; no bypassing.

zh.text: 请求修复初稿。

en.text: Request the fix.

zh.text: intro.md 开头两句已改写。

en.text: intro.md: the first two sentences were rewritten.

zh.text: 重跑同一个确定性闸门。

en.text: Rerun the same deterministic gate.

zh.text: check passed: 退出码 0。

en.text: check passed: exit code 0.

zh.text: 停止原因：闸门通过。完成声明指向退出码 0 的证据，而不是模型的自我评价。

en.text: Stop reason: the gate passed. The completion claim points at the exit-code-0 evidence, not the model's opinion of itself.

zh.text: 闸门没过。诊断问题，修复后重跑同一个闸门。

en.text: The gate did not pass. Diagnose the problem, fix it, rerun the same gate.

en.text: Request the fix.

zh.text: 连续两轮没有可验证的进展，预算即将耗尽：停止比继续撞墙诚实。

en.text: Two rounds with no verifiable progress and the budget is nearly gone: stopping is more honest than keep banging into the wall.

zh.text: 停止原因：预算耗尽。闸门始终没有变绿——没有证据就不写完成声明。

en.text: Stop reason: budget exhausted. The gate never went green — no evidence, no completion claim.

zh.title: 验证器强制的 loop：闸门、失败与修复
zh.question: 当 loop 已经能持续行动时，谁来判定“做完了”？失败之后，哪一步把完成声明变成可复核的证据？
zh.assumption: 这是提议中的验证器强制 loop 的教学示意：决策说明是讲解文本，不是模型的内部思考，命令只是文本、不会真实执行。现有 ralph.sh 还没有这样的 contract gate。
zh.observe: 观察：确定性闸门在哪一步推翻了模型的判断？预算耗尽时，loop 应该说什么？

en.title: A verifier-enforced loop: gate, failure, fix
en.question: Once a loop can keep acting, who decides “done” — and after a failure, which step turns a completion claim into checkable evidence?
en.assumption: A teaching sketch of a PROPOSED verifier-enforced loop: decision notes are explanatory text, not a model's inner thoughts, and commands are inert text that is never executed. The current ralph.sh has no such contract gate yet.
en.observe: Observe: where does the deterministic gate overrule the model? What should the loop say when the budget runs out?
